subject: Order Form questions, Ariba activation & PO routing for Cardinal Health
messages:
From: Kristin Shaw <kristin.shaw@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-team@cardinalhealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendor activation + questions on Order Form (Cardinal Health)

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We are ready to move forward but have a few operational asks before we can onboard Redwood into our procurement systems:

1) We need a version of the Order Form that reflects Cardinal-specific PO routing fields (Cost Center, Project Code, Approver ID).
2) Confirm whether Redwood will accept blanket POs and if so, how line-item breakdowns will appear on invoice.
3) We use Ariba/Coupa depending on BU — please send the exact vendor registration steps and any required attachments for Cardinal’s Ariba tenant.
4) Legal had a couple of redlines to the Order Form and MSA (indemnity + audit rights) — attached is the OrderForm-v1.pdf and a short summary doc.

Can we get a point person who can take these items and coordinate with our vendor onboarding team? We’d like vendor activation to happen the week of Sep 6.

Thanks,
Kristin Shaw
Sr. Strategic Sourcing Manager
Cardinal Health
Attachments: OrderForm-v1.pdf (Order form), summary-of-redlines.txt
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kristin Shaw <kristin.shaw@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation + questions on Order Form (Cardinal Health)

Kristin —

Appreciate the clear list. I’m the onboarding lead for this engagement; looping in Lauren (contracts) and Karthik (implementation) so we can cover legal + portal workstreams. High-level plan:

- Lauren will review the redlines and produce a tracked-changes Order Form.
- Karthik will confirm PO field mapping for Ariba/Coupa and share a PO template Redwood can consume.
- I’ll send the Ariba invite link and a step-by-step registration PDF for your vendor team.

Action items for Cardinal: please confirm the target BU (GPO vs Distribution) so we know which tenant (Ariba vs Coupa) to invite into. Also confirm whether you will issue a blanket PO or discrete POs month-to-month.

I attached a first pass (OrderForm-v2-redlined.pdf) with our internal comments to accelerate the review — not final. We can sign via DocuSign once legal and procurement align.

Proposed timeline: legal redline resolution by Tue Sep 1, portal invite and registration by Sep 3, vendor activated by Sep 7 if all goes well.

Best,
Michael Grant
Solutions Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm-v2-redlined.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Kristin Shaw <kristin.shaw@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor activation + questions on Order Form (Cardinal Health)

Hi all —

I reviewed the OrderForm-v2-redlined.pdf. Key points and proposed edits (see attached tracked changes):

- Indemnity: we can accept mutual indemnity but need to limit it to third-party claims and carve out Redwood’s models/data outputs. I added specific language to Section 7.
- Audit rights: acceptable with 30 days' notice and scope limited to transaction logs relevant to billed activity.
- PO language: we need a clause that binds the Order Form to the MSA and confirms that a Cardinal PO referencing the Order Form is sufficient for payment. Added suggested sentence in Section 2.
- Effective dates: please confirm whether Cardinal requires the Order Form to have a separate effective date or if signature on the MSA suffices.

I attached MSA-redlines-LB.docx (track changes) and a short summary. If Cardinal is OK with the proposed carve-outs, we can finalize the Order Form and send for signature via DocuSign.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA-redlines-LB.docx

From: procure-team@cardinalhealth.com <procure-team@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Kristin Shaw <kristin.shaw@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor activation + questions on Order Form (Cardinal Health)

Thanks Lauren — the tracked edits look reasonable; a few follow-ups from our side:

- PO template: attached a spreadsheet with required fields (PO-requirements-Cardinal.xlsx). Our system requires Cost Center, GL Account, Approver ID, and BU (GPO/Distribution). If you plan to accept blanket POs, we need to ensure Redwood can reconcile against line items per invoice.
- Portal mapping: we will need a CSV sample for vendor field mapping (vendor name, tax id, remit-to, remit-address, payment terms). Can you provide a sample export?
- Legal: indemnity carve-outs are okay but confirm Redwood’s position on liability caps for Services.

We’ve also attached our internal vendor onboarding checklist. Once we receive the updated Order Form and the CSV template, we’ll initiate the Ariba invite and provide the vendor ID.

Procurement Operations
Cardinal Health
Attachments: PO-requirements-Cardinal.xlsx, cardinal-vendor-checklist.pdf

Kristin / procurement team —

Thanks for the PO spreadsheet and checklist. Next steps from Redwood (this morning):

1) Attached is a CSV sample for vendor field mapping (supplier-fields-sample.csv) and an updated Order Form with Lauren’s edits incorporated.
2) We will accept blanket POs provided there is a reference to the Order Form number and line-item level detail on invoices; Karthik will validate invoice parsing against your PO format.
3) Ariba invite: I’ve generated a tenant invite link (Ariba: https://ariba.cardinalhealth.com/vendor-portal/invite/ABC123). Please have your vendor ops team click the link and follow the registration steps in the attached supplier-registration-steps.pdf.

If you can confirm the BU (GPO) and send over a test PO next week, Karthik and I will run a quick parsing validation in our sandbox and confirm activation. Happy to stand up a 30-minute call Wed Sep 2 to walk the vendor ops team through the registration flow.

Best,
Michael Grant
Solutions Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: supplier-registration-steps.pdf, supplier-fields-sample.csv, OrderForm-final-for-signature.pdf
